# WPKlik

> > WPKlik is a comprehensive WordPress database providing curated guides, tutorials, and resources for themes, plugins, and web design.

WPKlik serves as a central knowledge hub for WordPress professionals and enthusiasts, offering in-depth guides to theme selection, step-by-step tutorials for popular builders like Elementor, and curated collections of development resources. The site specializes in helping users find the right WordPress solutions for portfolios, ecommerce, and creative projects.

## Key Topics

- WordPress
- WordPress Themes
- WordPress Plugins
- Elementor
- WooCommerce
- Portfolio Websites
- Web Design Resources
- Page Builders
- Free WordPress Themes
- WordPress Tutorials
- Theme Selection
- LearnDash
- Schema Plugins
- WordPress Security

## WordPress Themes & Selection

- [20+ Free WordPress Themes for Different Businesses](https://wpklik.com/wordpress-themes/free-wordpress-themes): Guide to 20+ free WordPress themes for various business types and needs.
- [25+ Best Artist Portfolio WordPress Themes](https://wpklik.com/wordpress-themes/artist-portfolio-wordpress-themes): Curated guide to 25+ artist portfolio WordPress themes for creative professionals.
- [5+ Best Free Responsive Themes with Demo Content](https://wpklik.com/wordpress-themes/free-responsive-themes-with-demo-content): Roundup of free responsive WordPress themes with demo content included.

## WordPress Tutorials & How-To Guides

- [How to Update WordPress the Simplest Way](https://wpklik.com/wordpress-tutorials/how-to-update-wordpress): Step-by-step tutorial on updating WordPress safely and easily.
- [Elementor Team Member Widget: How to Introduce Your Team](https://wpklik.com/wordpress-tutorials/elementor-team-member-widget): Tutorial on using Elementor's team member widget to showcase your team.
- [How to Disable Right Click in WordPress](https://wpklik.com/wordpress-tutorials/disable-right-click-in-wordpress): Tutorial on disabling right-click functionality in WordPress for security.
- [How to Start an Anonymous Blog and Why You Should (Not) Do It](https://wpklik.com/wordpress-tutorials/start-an-anonymous-blog): Guide on starting an anonymous WordPress blog with privacy considerations.
